main.summary: Runs jittered periodic recovery for durable publication journals left by interrupted publication workflows.

field.name: scopes
field.summary: Factory used to create a scoped service provider for each recovery attempt.

field.name: coordinator
field.summary: Coordinates exclusive item access across concurrent and cross-process transfer operations.

field.name: grainFactory
field.summary: Creates Orleans clients used to update catalog grains during publication recovery.

field.name: dataConfigs
field.summary: Resolves configured tenant storage for trusted publication-recovery candidates.

field.name: storageFactory
field.summary: Creates token-scoped tenant storage instances used to read and clean recovery artifacts.

field.name: options
field.summary: Controls scan polling, leader retry, jitter, candidate paging, and terminal failure handling.

field.name: leaderLock
field.summary: Provides a named PostgreSQL advisory-lock lease so only one replica scans and processes recovery journals at a time.

constructor.name: TransferPublicationRecoveryAgent
constructor.summary: Initializes the publication recovery agent dependencies and recovery policy.
constructor.param: Factory used to create a scoped service provider for each recovery attempt.
Coordinates exclusive item access across concurrent and cross-process transfer operations.
Creates Orleans clients used to update catalog grains during publication recovery.
Resolves configured tenant storage for trusted recovery candidates.
Creates storage clients for token-scoped publication artifacts.
Provides exclusive named database-backed worker leadership.
Controls scan polling, leader retry, jitter, candidate paging, and terminal failure threshold.

method.name: ExecuteAsync
method.summary: Waits a randomized startup delay, acquires named PostgreSQL advisory-lock leadership, retries followers at the configured leader retry interval, verifies the lock connection, scans candidates in configured pages up to a fixed UTC cutoff, and retains leadership across jittered recovery cycles until the host is stopping.
method.param: Signals that the hosted service must stop scanning and exit.

method.name: CreateRecoveryStore
method.summary: Selects the trusted candidate's catalog in the scoped tenant storage context before recovery accesses payloads.
method.param: Publication store used for recovery.
Configured storage silo for the candidate catalog.
Scoped services containing tenant storage context.
method.returns: Publication store with its tenant context initialized.

method.name: GetRandomDelay
method.summary: Returns a uniformly selected delay from zero through the supplied maximum, inclusive.
method.param: Maximum permitted delay.
method.returns: Random delay, or zero when the maximum is zero.

method.name: RecoverPublicationAsync
method.summary: Acquires cross-process item and session locks for a candidate, reloads the current journal, confirms that its catalog-owned item instance token is still active, removes finalized journals without requiring a storage silo, then finalizes or records failure according to the configured recovery policy.
method.param: Lightweight candidate from the current recovery scan.
Scoped publication store used to load, advance, and retire the journal.
Scoped service provider used to resolve the transfer-family services.
Cancellation token for the recovery attempt.

method.name: RecoverSegmentedAsync
method.summary: Recovers a segmented publication only when the session manifest item instance token matches the journal, then resumes the artifact, catalog, and transfer-finalization phases.
method.param: Durable journal describing the interrupted segmented publication.
Configured storage silo that owns the transfer artifacts.
Mutation scope owning the item and session locks for the recovery attempt.
Segmented transfer service used to resume and finalize the publication.
Scoped publication store used to load transfer artifacts and advance the journal.
Cancellation token for the recovery attempt.
method.returns: A task that reports whether all phases are finalized or provides the reason recovery must be retried.

method.name: RecoverStreamAsync
method.summary: Recovers a stream publication only when the session manifest item instance token matches the journal, then replays journal-authoritative preparation and resumes artifact, catalog, and transfer-finalization phases.
method.param: Durable journal describing the interrupted stream publication.
Configured storage silo that owns the transfer artifacts.
Mutation scope owning the item and session locks for the recovery attempt.
Stream transfer service used to resume and finalize the publication.
Scoped publication store used to load transfer artifacts and advance the journal.
Cancellation token for the recovery attempt.
method.returns: A task that reports whether all phases are finalized or provides the reason recovery must be retried.

method.name: RecordFailureAsync
method.summary: Records a recovery failure and retains the journal in the Failed phase when the configured retry threshold is reached.
method.param: Journal whose attempt metadata should be updated.
Scoped publication store used to record the journal failure and terminal phase.
Failure reason produced by the recovery attempt.
Cancellation token for recording the failure.
